_note: Expanded uncertainties (k = 2) for the 33210A / 33220A / 33250A procedure that are NOT taken from the laboratory A2LA scope. AC amplitude and low-frequency flatness use the scope's AC Voltage - Measure entry and the timebase uses Frequency - Measure; set a value here to override them. RF flatness (power meter) has no scope entry, so it shows N/A until FLAT is filled in. uncertainty = rel x |reading| + abs, in the unit given. A blank (null) entry falls back to the scope, or N/A.
